items.title: Razer Reclusa X Mini 65% gaming keyboard review
items.summary: A budget mini keeb that somehow manages to feel high-end.
items.body: While Razer makes some excellent headsets, laptops, and gaming mice, I've never been particularly keen on its keyboards. They tend to be decent devices overall, but are usually expensive enough that you can get more bang for your buck from the competition. However, there's a new budget offering in town from the big green snake, and it's called the Razer Reclusa X Mini 65%. Those of you familiar with keyboard percentage figures (and the term "mini") will likely deduce that this is a small keeb. There's no numpad to be found here, but at least you get all the main keys needed for day to day usage. It doesn't feel constrictive to type on, and it sure is a good-looking device—but the main thing that impresses me is the build quality, especially given the MSRP. This is a $50 / £60 gaming keyboard, but it feels more expensive than that. The doubleshot ABS keycaps are crisp, the switches are meaty, and its diminutive frame resists flexing to an admirable degree. If you told me this sharp little keyboard retailed for $80, I would absolutely believe you. For $50 at full price? I think it's a damn good bit of gaming hardware for the cash. You can scour the internet for the files you need, though there are some software options that automate the process. items.title: Bethesda says that Obsidian's 'creative identity' will be preserved, just months after multiple projects were cancelled and it was told to make a Fallout game
items.summary: I don't know about that one, chief.
items.body: Listen, you can say what you want about Avowed—I wouldn't even blame you if you didn't like it, or much of what has come out of Obsidian's recent catalogue. There's even a tiny, selfish scrap of my gamer heart that's secretly very glad that Obsidian is working on a new Fallout game, again . But this is pretty rich, given the grinder that Obsidian's been put through in the past few months. As a reminder, in July, 25% of Obsidian's staff was laid off during Xbox's ongoing, brutal "reset", totalling around 52 employees. When this happened, a sequel to Avowed was cancelled, along with multiple unannounced games. More recently, Obsidian's being folded into Bethesda . Now, in fairness to Braff, it's entirely possible that this particular merging did not ruin Obsidian's ability to express itself. It's entirely possible that the post-bloodletting Obsidian we were left with in July and the one currently under Bethesda now are pretty much interchangeable. However, the idea that Obsidian's creative identity has been respected by these moves overall is laughable—cancelling multiple projects is the opposite of that, actually. items.title: Alienware is working on a fix for the one thing that stops its new 39-inch 5K2K OLED gaming monitor from being perfect
items.summary: This fix could hurt my wallet.
items.body: The Alienware AW3926QW is undoubtedly my favourite monitor of the moment , maybe even ever. It has just one problem that prevented me from giving it an unambiguous buy recommendation. And now it seems Alienware is about to fix it. The AW3926QW is of course a 39-inch 5K2K OLED masterpiece. It's huge, it has the pixel density of a 32-inch 4K panel and it comes with LG's very latest Tandem WOLED panel tech complete with RGB-stripe subpixels for purists like me. It's even relatively affordable (given its specs) at around $1,100 . There was just one problem. As I explained in my review, "during gaming the edges of the panel gradually dim ever so slightly," an issue generally referred to as "vignetting." The reason why this happens comes down to a feature called CPC, or Convex Power Control. "It’s an LG Display WOLED panel protection feature and dims all four edges of the display to help prevent burn-in. As far as I am aware, it can't be toggled on or off on this Alienware, but if CPC is causing the vignette issue, it should be easy to address in a firmware update. items.title: "لا يستطيع نسيان الرعب".. مهاجم إنجلترا السابق يعترف بتعرضه لاعتداء جنسي
items.summary: لعب لنيوكاسل وليفربول
items.body: لعب لنيوكاسل وليفربول كشف مهاجم منتخب إنجلترا السابق، عن تعرضه لاعتداء جنسي في هجوم "مؤلم" قبل بضع سنوات. واعترف مهاجم إنجلترا السابق، البالغ من العمر 37 عامًا، بصراحة أنه "لا يستطيع نسيان" الرعب الذي عاشه، في اعتراف صادم في سيرته الذاتية، التي جاءت بعنوان "الاعتراف بذلك". ووفقا لصحيفة " ذا صن "، روى آندي كارول، نجم نيوكاسل وليفربول السابق كيف ناقش مع صديقته لو تيسديل، البالغة من العمر 42 عامًا، ما إذا كان سيتحدث عن الهجوم، لكن بعد  فترة طويلة، قرر "في اللحظة الأخيرة إدراجه في كتابه". وقال آندي: "حدث لي شيء ما قبل بضع سنوات كان صادماً للغاية لدرجة أنني قررت إدراجه في هذا الكتاب في اللحظة الأخيرة فقط". يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة وتابع: "لقد تعرضت لاعتداء جنسي، ها قد قلتها. إنه أمر مخيف حتى مجرد التفكير فيه، ولم يكن يعلم به سوى عدد قليل من الناس قبل الآن". وأضاف: "لقد أمضيت أنا و تيسديل الكثير من الوقت في مناقشة ما إذا كان ينبغي ذكر ذلك في هذا الكتاب". وأضاف مهاجم إنجلترا السابق: "من المخيف التحدث عن ذلك، لكنه ساهم في تكوين شخصيتي اليوم بقدر ما ساهمت أي من الأشياء الجيدة". وأردف: "إذا ساعد حديثي عن هذا الأمر شخصًا واحدًا فقط، فسيكون ذلك جيدًا، وسيكون الأمر يستحق العناء". وأكدت الصحيفة أنه لم يرد في الكتاب أي تفاصيل أخرى عن الهجوم.

items.body: My first MMO character was... Ovidlords, Night-elf Druid Born: ~2006 Game: World of Warcraft After a friend bought me a video game bundle that included Diablo 2 and WoW, I jumped into Diablo and thought the Druid seemed like the coolest thing I’d ever seen. When I made the jump to paying a monthly sub for WoW, I was ecstatic to find I could also roll a shape-shifting Druid, so Ovidlords was born. I was a Druid tank at a time when absolutely no one wanted that. I managed to MT Gruul in the Burning Crusade when I was told that was impossible. He also eventually ended up getting our server-first Ashes of Al’ar when we beat Kael-thas. The account has since been deleted, but I’ll absolutely always remember my bear-y first MMO character. items.body: كوناتي غادر معسكر الديوك بسبب "التواء خفيف" في الركبة ساد الهدوء داخل ريال مدريد بشأن إصابة إبراهيما كوناتي، بعدما غادر مدافع المنتخب الفرنسي معسكر "الديوك" بسبب التواء خفيف في الركبة اليمنى، في الوقت الذي يستعد فيه النادي الملكي لإجراء فحوصات إضافية للاطمئنان على حالته بشكل دقيق. وكانت إصابة كوناتي قد أثارت بعض المخاوف داخل ريال مدريد، لكنها سرعان ما تراجعت، بعدما خضع اللاعب لفحوصات مع الجهاز الطبي للمنتخب الفرنسي، الذي ظل على تواصل مستمر مع النادي الإسباني لإطلاعه على تطورات حالته، حسب صحيفة " موندو ديبورتيفو " الإسبانية. وقرر مسؤولو المنتخب الفرنسي عدم المجازفة بالمدافع ، رغم أن الإصابة وُصفت بالخفيفة، ليغادر المعسكر ويعود إلى العاصمة الإسبانية لمواصلة عملية التعافي. وحصل ريال مدريد على تفاصيل الحالة الصحية لكوناتي أولًا بأول، فيما سيخضع اللاعب لفحوصات جديدة داخل النادي لتحديد مدى إصابة الركبة ومدة غيابه المحتملة. ورغم ذلك، لا تسود حالة من القلق داخل ريال مدريد، إذ إن التقديرات الحالية لا تستبعد إمكانية لحاق كوناتي بمواجهة فياريال يوم 10 أكتوبر المقبل على ملعب "سانتياجو برنابيو". ويظل موعد عودة المدافع الفرنسي مرتبطًا بتطور حالة ركبته خلال الأيام المقبلة، في انتظار نتائج الفحوصات الجديدة وتحديد مدى جاهزيته للمشاركة.

items.title: The Industrial Revolution is the reason RPGs have area-of-effect spells: A PC Gamer Causality Chain™
items.summary: Spl-ASH damage.
items.body: Causality Chain is a series at PC Gamer exploring the unlikely links between history, culture, and videogames. Every time you cast a meteor spell in Diablo 2 or a cloud of daggers in Baldur's Gate 3, you are taking part in a chain of history—a causality chain, if you will—that dates back to the 18th century, when nobody had thought about taking a "warlock dip" since the Salem witch trials. And at that time, it had a very different meaning. Today we trace the arc of history from the death of the agrarian period, all the way forward to that time you managed to set fire to five goblins at once and felt quite good about how clever you were. We chart the curious contours of cause and effect, and then we put our chins into our hands and we say, "Hmmm. Yes. This is good." Turns out, the team I've worked with for years, who I thought I could trust, who I've shared a laugh with, who I thought were my friends, are complete and utter fools. As are most of you—soz. items.title: Halo Studios cinematic director promoted, then laid off in the same week
items.summary: Just when I think I can't be surprised anymore, something like this happens.
items.body: Not that things are great for anybody at the moment, but I'm not entirely sure how anyone in the videogame industry keeps their head together—Josh Daniels, one of the latest victims in Xbox's brutal series of resets , has been promoted and then laid off in the same week. For some context, this forms part of the previously-announced 1,600 layoffs that'll be happening as Xbox's fiscal year whirls around . This is, of course, after a 1,600-person bloodbath that preceded it, leaving a sword dangling precariously over Microsoft's remaining videogame studios. Daniels' absurd circumstances remind me of a report, which surfaced in July , that described a situation in which an anonymous source told Game Developer their layoffs "left colleagues scrambling to make sense of the situation using unofficial channels—many of which are overseen by union members and organizers." Also in July, Bethesda developers were also reportedly told they had jobs until September right before the axe swung . What's clear is this: Nothing, absolutely nothing, signals safety in the videogame industry anymore. Even if you're promoted, you can get punted from a studio in the same week .
